title: Minimum Bitwise OR From Grid
summary: Given a 2D integer array grid with dimensions m x n, select exactly one integer from each row.
statement: Given a 2D integer array grid with dimensions m x n, select exactly one integer from each row. Return an integer representing the minimum possible bitwise OR of the selected integers from each row.
constraints: grid is nonempty, every row is nonempty, and values are nonnegative.
Choose exactly one value from every row.
Return the minimum possible bitwise OR of the chosen values.
hints: Decide result bits from most significant to least significant.
Tentatively keep the current bit zero while allowing all undecided lower bits to be one.
The bit may remain zero only if every row contains at least one value using no forbidden bit.
Row choices are independent once an allowed mask is fixed; the first infeasible high bit must be included, giving the lexicographically smallest bit pattern.
editorial: Row choices are independent once an allowed mask is fixed; the first infeasible high bit must be included, giving the lexicographically smallest bit pattern.

tests.explanation: Choosing one and two produces OR three, the minimum.
The only selected value is zero, so the result is zero.
